description: Move a card to another column on the SAME board. Give the target column by id or by title (resolved against the card's own board). For moving to a DIFFERENT board use zuuna_move_card_to_board.

card.description: Card key (e.g. "ZNA-2001") or card id. Both work everywhere a card is addressed.
